¡· + de nas ka mil gyi slob dpon shī la mi/ ) de la bod yul dbus kyi slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas 'bum gyis gsan pa las chu mo bya'i lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu drug nas brtsams nas zla ba gnyis kyi bar du ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + bdag dang ) 'dul ba 'dzin pa chos kyi mgon po la sogs pa 'gas 'dul ba ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + lung ) yongs su rdzogs pa thos so// //rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje snying po/ klu'i mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa/ bhaṃ ga la pa/ mngon shes can/ rdo rje gdan gyi kṛṣ+ṇa pa/ 'gos lo tsā ba/ rta nag gi mo yu sgom thung*/ dbus pa sgom chen/ zhang spang khang ba/ slob dpon dbang rin/ slob dpon shākya rdo rje las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las/ ma hā mā yā'i 'grel pa slob dpon shān+ti pas mdzad pa'i yon tan ldan ma/ kṛṣ+ṇa pas mdzad pa'i dran pa ma rnams thos so// //paṇ+ḍi ta a bha ya/ tsā mi lo tsā ba/ stengs pa lo tsā ba/ shel dkar lo tsā ba/ shes rab seng ge rgya rnal 'byor/ khams pa shākya rdo rje las brgyud nas | slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma thos so | | dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ lha sa dan 'bag gi chos kyi mgon po las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud thos so/ /sangs rgyas bsam gtan pa ¡Ã bcu gnyis ( ¡¶ zha ¡· tshul khrims ) / wā ra ṇā sī'i slob dpon rdo rje go cha/ dza ya se na/ dza ma ta thā/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ ur+yan pa/ sangs rgyas zhi ba/ kha che shrād+dhā ka ra/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ dpal gyi dbang phyug jo bo gong gnas pa/ jo bo lha btsun/ gdong sngon pa/ jo bo dge bsnyen/ khung phyag pa/ khyung dngos grub/ g.yag sde pa dbang rin/ ting nge 'dzin dpal bzang po/ slob dpon rngog rnams las brgyud nas | slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las don yod zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rtog pa thos so//

//kṛṣ+ṇa paṇ+ḍi ta nag tsho lo tsā ba/ sbug ston rgya gar rgyal po/ sbug ston chung ba/ sgang rin chen rdo rje/ gze ba blo ldan seng ge gze ba don grub seng ge de'i sras byang chub mgon po/ slob dpon khams pa las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa lnga thos so/ /sangs rgyas nas/ bla ma ba ri ba'i bar 'dra/ de nas bla ma mar ston/ dan 'bag gi gnyan ston grags rgyal/ de'i dbon po gnyan ston rin chen grags/ gnas brtan dkon seng | de'i sras slob dpon ldog las brgyud pa dang*/ yang paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang*/ gan pa nas brgyud de 'ongs pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma/ rma bya chen mo/ so sor 'brang ba chen mo/ bsil ba'i tshal chen mo/ gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa chen mo'i mdo rnams thos so/ /jo bo rin chen bzang po dang*/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab las byung ba | bla ma 'ga' zhig brgyud pa'i mthar/ gtsang khang gi khri ston mkhan po gnas rnying pa/ slob dpon chos kyi 'od zer las byung ba/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las | 'jam pa'i dpal nam mkha' ltar yangs shing dri ma med pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus nas de'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyang thos so/ /rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje snying po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ma taṃ gi ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lho brag pa/ rngog chos kyi rdo rje/ sras mdo sde/ rang pū gong pa/ de gnyis la yul la stod gcung pa'i grog ra sram phug pas zhus/ mnga' ris kyi ston pa dkon mchog 'bar/ rgyang mkhar ngo dmar gyi mkhan po tshul khrims skyabs/ gdan sa mkhan po phag skyabs/ rgyang ro gser sdings kyi grub thob ston gzhon/ ma ngag dge sdings pa slob dpon chos kyi 'od zer las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las rdo rje gur rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba zhus nas de'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyang thos so/

/sangs rgyas grub pa'i slob dpon snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā ri/ byang chub bzang po/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ mchims brtson 'grus seng ge rgya zhang phug pa/ bal po dbang phyug mgon las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du tshe dbang zhus nas tshe dpag med kyi gzungs/ slobadapon dze tā ris mdzad pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'chi med rnga sgra'i rgyal po'i gzungs rnams thos so/ /'jam dpal/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ kun dga' snying po/ tha ga na shān+ti pa/ shrād+dhā ka ra/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ skyang pa chos kyi blo gros/ se ston skyabs se/ sra po/ rong pa dkon mchog mkhar/ ston pa dbang rin/ slob dpon shākya rdo rje las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las/ ye shes zhabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ slob dpon shān+ti pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog slob dpon dri med sbas pas mdzad pa'i le'u bcu bdun gyi 'grel pa/ de nyid kyi slob ma/ slob dpon zla ba'i 'od kyis mdzad pa'i le'u bco brgyad pa'i 'grel pa ste rgyan zhes bya bar grags pa dang*/ slob dpon tse lu pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa rin po che'i ljon sh-ing zhes bya ba/ ye shes zhabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba spyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba dang*/ sgrub pa'i thabs kun tu bzang po'i 'grel pa slob dpon tha ga nas mdzad pa dang*/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon sman pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba rnams thos so// //bla ma rje btsun za lung gi dge bshes sde/ slob dpon khams pa las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgya 'bum las brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa/ slob dpon mi thub zla bas mdzad pa ku mu ti thos la sngon bla ma chos rje las kyang thos so//

//slob dpon pad+ma chung ba/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ de wa pa/ k+ṣi ti gar+bha/ khu lo tsā ba/ rong pa mgar dge 'gos ston khri bzang*/ slob dpon dbang tshul/ mkhan po dbang rin/ slob dpon khams pa nas brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa pad+ma can thos so/ / slob dpon shān+ti pa/ lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa/ 'gur mo pa/ gtsang nam mkha' ston pa thub pa/ slob dpon dbang rin/ slob dpon khams pa las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las mu tig phreng ba thos so/ /slob dpon shān+ti pa/ lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa/ 'gur mo ba/ bram ze nag po zhabs/ 'gos lo tsā ba/ rta nag pa sgom thub/ shab pa dge byang*/ zhang spang khang pa/ 'khun ston gzhon/ slob dpon dbang rin/ slob dpon ba ri ba las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las rin po che'i phreng ba thos so// //bla ma 'gos lo tsā ba las byung ba | slob dpon ldog las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa dran pa'i 'byung gnas thos so// //slob dpon mi thub zla ba dang*/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra nas brgyud de 'ongs pa/ slob dpon khams pa las gsan pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ rin po che'i tshogs dang*/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa gnyis ka'i bshad sbyar zhes bya ba dang*/ yang slob dpon dpal ldan grags pas mdzad pa rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang*/ dpa' bo yid du 'ong ba'i dka' 'grel zhes bya ba dang*/ yang mi thub zla bas mdzad pa'i yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba dang*/ a bha yā ka ras mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'khrul spong zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las thos so/ /slob dpon dril bu pa/ slob dpon zla ba pa | dzā lan+dha ra/ nag po pa/ dge ba'i mgon po/ ti lo pa/ nā rau pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/

bla ma mar ston chos kyi blo gros/ gze ba blo ldan/ gze ba don grub seng ge gze ba bde mchog rdo rje/ slob dpon khams pa las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las slob dpon lwa ba pas mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gter zhes bya ba dang*/ slob dpon ār+ya de was mdzad pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bsdus don gyi 'grel pa/ slob dpon dzā lan+dha ras mdzad pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i de kho na nyid grub pa dang*/ slob dpon dpag med rdo rjes mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na nyid snang ba/ slob dpon dge ba'i mgon pos mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo dang*/ slob dpon ku sa li pas mdzad pa/ snying po'i de kho na nyid snang ba dang*/ slob dpon 'jigs med grags pas mdzad pa lhan cig skyes pa'i snang ba rnams dang*/ rdo rje phag mo lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dril bu pas mdzad pa dang*/ phag mo dkar mo'i sgrub thabs dril bu pas mdzad pa dang*/ rdo rje gnod mdzes kyi sgrub thabs pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa dang*/ yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub thabs mai trī pas mdzad pa dang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs nā ro pas mdzad pa dang | ka na ka shrīs mdzad pa'i dpa' bo drug gi sgrub thabs dang*/ yang 'khor lo sdom pa'i 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrub thabs pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa rnams te nam mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs rnams thos so/ /yang slob dpon dril bu pas mdzad par grags pa rim lnga'i 'grel pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma kun spyod kyi 'grel pa ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa dang*/ slob dpon ka li ka pas mdzad pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ bram ze nag po pas mdzad pa'i yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ ¡Ã pradz+nyā ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dz+nya na ) bha dras mdzad pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma na shrīs mdzad pa'i dpa' bo gcig pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/

slob dpon bram ze bi kā ras mdzad pa'i rje btsun he ru ka'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa bde mchog gi sgrub pa'i thabs/ de kho na nyid kyi snying po zhes bya ba rnams thos so// //sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ klu'i byang chub/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ chung ba/ bla ma ba ri ba/ rje sa skya pa/ rta stag so bo/ gze ba don grub ye shes/ bla ma khams pa las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las/ dzam+bha la'i mtshan brgya rtsa pa gzungs dang bcas pa dang*/ de'i 'grel pa slob dpon mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa thos so// //slob dpon klu sgrub/ ma tang gi spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ lha'i rigs kyi blo gros/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ a ba dhū tī/ ga ya dha ra/ 'gos lo tsā ba/ rta nag pa sgom thung*/ zhang pa khang pa/ 'khun ston gzhon/ ri lung phug pa dkon mchog 'bar/ slob dpon dbang rin/ slob dpon khams pa las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las rdo rje gur gyi 'grel pa/ slob dpon lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyis mdzad pa dang*/ rdo rje gur le'u lnga'i 'grel pa rgyal po in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa thos so// //yang slob dpon khams pa las brgyud nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel pa/ nā ro pas mdzad par grags pa dang*/ lha mo bzhis zhus kyi 'grel pa/ slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ jo bo smṛ tis bsgyur pa thos so// //jo bo rje/ nag tsho lo tsā ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ spen phug pa/ zhang ye shes rgyal mtshan/ gze ba don grub ye shes/ slob dpon khams pa las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ slob dpon ka ran+dhis mdzad pa rngog gis bsgyur ba thos so// //rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/

slob dpon nyi ma'i snying po/ mkha' 'gro ma bha ma na ra/ dpal ku tu rū pa/ grub thob ka ro pa/ kor ni rū pa/ nyang ston rdo rje ye shes/ gzhu pa gnyen pa/ kha rag gtsang ston/ sprul sku rgyan zhig dge bshes ston gzungs/ slob dpon mgon po dpal las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lhan cig skyes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud/ rab tu mi gnas pa bstan pa'i rgyud/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba gnyis su med pa'i rgyud/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa rnams thos so

|| || jo bo rje dang*/ bha dan+ta dang*/ gnyos lo tsā ba nas brgyud nas/ ka ba jo 'bum dang*/ gnyi mo ba seng ge rgyal mtshan las/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum gyis gsan pa'i rtsa ltung rgya cher 'grel pa thos so// //sangs rgyas byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ bud+dha pa li ta/ bud+dhā dz+nyā na/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ shān+ti pa/ dz+nyā na shrī/ gnyags lo tsā ba/ shākya blo gros/ dwags khyung gnyis/ lha rje khyem pa/ so chos she lho pa kun mkhyen/ chos kyi blo gros/ slob dpon rin chen bzang po las gsan nas brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon shān+ti pas mdzad pa'i snying po mchog nyi khri'i 'grel pa dag ldan dang*/ yang*/ a bha ya/ shud po lo tsā ba/ so chos she dar ma seng ge chos dpal | rin bzang las brgyud nas/ brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa a bha ya ka ras mdzad pa gnad kyi zla zer rnams thos so// //jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ rin chen gsal/ yon tan grags/ rdo rje 'bum/ rnam mkhyen/ slob dpon chos mgon po las brgyu?d nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las ched du brjod pa'i tshoms kyi 'grel pa/ nyan thos kyi slob dpon chen po/ pradz+nyā warma zhes bya bas thos so | | slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen las brgyud nas/ slob dpon ston chos las gsan pa/ shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa ka ma la shī las mdzad pa thos so/ /slob dpon ston chos las gsan pa/ sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa thos so/ /yang lha sa'i slob dpon ldog las gsan pa'i tshul gsum gyi sgron ma yang thosaso/ /yang slob dpon chos ston las gsan pa'i sā lu ljang pa dang*/ rdo rje gcod pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa thos so// //sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ paṇ+ḍi ta grub pa'i rdo rje

| 'jam pa'i nga ro/ dpe med rdo rje/ saṅgi rdo rje/ khu yug rdo rje/ pad+ma'i chung ngu zhabs | bud+dha gup+ta/ dbas mañju shrī dharma kīrti/ sum ston zhung bu ston pa/ don sman g.yung drung snying po/ phyug mtshams/ lha snying po/ jo bo pha rgan/ khams kyi sum ske nag bongs byin chung*/ ra shags zla ba gnyan/ mchims zhang btsun/ phyug mtshams | mchims pa/ rje gdong sngon pa/ phar ban/ mkhan po g.yag sde ba dbang rin | ting nge 'dzin dpal bzang po/ slob dpon jo sras rdog bya'u rgyal las brgyud nas/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa thos so// //sangs rgyas/ rgyal po grags pa | slob dpon dus 'khor zhabs che ba/ chung ba/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ lha rje dkon mchog bsrungs/ sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ bla ma yu mo ba/ sras dar ma dbang phyug se 'jam/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ slob dpon lha pa las brgyud nas | slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod phan yon dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon dus 'khor zhabs kyis mdzad par grags pa | a bha ya badz+ra dang*/ rdo rje rgyal pos bsgyur ba thos so// //lho pa kun mkhyen dang*/ slob dpon ston chos las brgyud nas/ legs par grub pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa dang*/ 'da' ka ye shes kyi 'grel pa slob dpon pradz+nya sa mu dras mdzad pa rnams thos so/ /bla ma sa skya pa yab sras dang*/ za lung gi dge bshes lde ba/ slob dpon khams pa las brgyud nas/ ba ri gser chos su grags pa thos so/ /phag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyi shu bzhi dang lnga la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ bla ma nā ro pa/ slob dpon shes rab bzang po/ rab tu gsang ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta su badz+ra/ lo tsā ba shel dkar chos kyi shes rab/ rkang dbang phyug blo gros/ mgar rdo rje snying po/

nyang ston lce 'bar/ ral ston snying 'bar/ zla cog skya shod pa/ lug mgo ba/ rkyang po dar ma grags/ khri ston/ nyang stod kyi mkhan po gnas rnying pa/ slob dpon chos kyi 'od zer las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las nam mkha'i dri med rigs bsdus pa'i dbang bskur ba thos so/ /tshes nyi shu bdun dang*/ brgyad la 'jam dpal/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra che ba/ a mo gha badz+ra chung ba/ skyo 'od 'byung*/ gtsang yang dag 'bar/ de'i sras yang dag rdo rje/ rdo rje rgyal po/ gze ba don grub ye shes/ slob dpon khams pa las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las skyo lugs kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus so/ /zla ba bcu pa'i tshes dgu dang*/ dgu lhag lhag pa la/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad chen po/ phyag na rdo rje/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje chos/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti che ba/ in+d+ra bhū ti bar pa/ bi na shrī/ in+d+ra bhū ti chung ba | slob dpon klu sgrub/ klu'i byang chub/ chos kyi rdo rje/ pad+ma rdo rje/ kun dga' snying po/ pradz+nyā sid+dhiḥ shes rab bskyangs/ mu ti dha warma/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/ shrad+dhā ka ra/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ pu rangs lo chung*/ zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab | langs so ston nag mgo 'bum grags/ mgo dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rdo rje/ mgo dngos grub mgon rnams las brgyud nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum las dpal mchog rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thos so || || tshes bcu dgu la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun gyi sgrub thabs/ mtshan ma gyen 'greng gi man ngag rwa la sems gzung ba'i man ngag gtor ma'i cho ga la li tas mdzad pa rnams thos so/ /'khrungs yul dbus te gdung rus dpe/ yab 'od po btsan/ yum chung rgyan/ sras kyi mkhan po nya ra thang pa shes rab byang

chub | slob dpon shes rab mgon/ gsang ste ba dar ma dbang phyug las bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /dgung snying ni byā gh+ra'o/ /phyi res sa skyar 'ongs pa'i dus su/ bla ma rga lo tsā la glang lo dpyid zla ra ba la/ dpal a pa rā dzi ta'i sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa thos so/ /glang lo dgun zla ra ba la slob dpon spyil phu ba la/ slob dpon blo brtan gyis mdzad pa'i sum cu pa'i 'grel pa dang*/ slob dpon ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + btsun pa ) ngo bo nyid med pas mdzad pa'i mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel bshad thos so | | sa pho stag gi lo dpyi?d zla ba 'bring po'i yar ngo la/ slob dpon rga lo la dzaṅgu la'i gzungs sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa dang*/ par+ṇa sha wa ri'i gzungs sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa dang*/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi gzungs sgrub thabs dang bcas pa thos so// //༄༅/ / ¡Ã slob dpon bsod nams seng ge'i spyan sngar 'phrin du zhu ba ( ¡¶ zha ¡· 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung sgros thor bu ) bzhugs/ ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sing+nghaṃ/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma dam pa dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shais kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi rje'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i mthus 'phrin du zhu ba'i yi ge 'di bri bar bya'o | | bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs phul du byung ba bsags pas che ba'i yon tan gyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i rten rnam par dag par sku 'khrungs nas/ sngon gyi smon lam las grub pa'i mthus bslab pa gsum gyis lus yongs su rdzogs pas yang dag pa'i bla ma rgya mtsho'i gling du/ blo gros mi zad pa'i gru bo che/ brtson pa'i ded dpon gyis bstan pa la zhugs nas/ legs par bshad pa nor bu'i tshogs yang dag par blangs te/ yon tan rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pas mkhas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs zil gyis mnan nas/

de dag gi yid rab tu 'phrog par mdzad pa'i skyes bu chen po/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi ston pa/ slob dpon bsod nams seng ge'i spyan sngar/ shākya'i dge tshul rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal spangs te gus pa'i yid kyis gsol pa/ 'dir bla ma chos kyi rje dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang mkhyen ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + brtse ) rab tu ldan pa de'ang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du/ sems can gyi don rgya che bar dgongs nas de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya bar | mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar zhal gyis bzhes te/ rnam par 'phrul ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + pa bsam gyi mi khyab ) pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa bstan nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan to/ /'on kyang chos kyi rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ da dung khyed rnams ci'i sgo nas kyang legs par 'ongs zhes bka' gnang ba dang*/ rgyal po'ang so zin cing*/ rgyal khams bde bar yong*/ skabs don la/ da res rgyal pos thugs la btags nas ban+de dang*/ bon po la sogs pa gnam mchod pa rnams la dmag khral med par sdod/ de'i mgo gnyer dang ban+de thams cad sa skya pa shes su chug gsungs pa'i lung byon/ de'i 'ja' sa bskyal nas mi rnams brtsi ba dang*/ slob dpon spyan 'dren pa'i don la rdo rje 'brug mngag pa yin/ 'dir chos kyi rje bzhugs pa'i dus na'ang rgyal bu'i ¡Ã don du ( ¡¶ zha ¡· drung du yang yang ) 'byon dgos pa dang*/ 'phral gyi bsod nams kyis g.yengs pas/ nged rang gi yid tshims pa'i chos 'chad nyan gyi long ma byung bas/ khyed las chos kyi lung mang du len pa dang*/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan slob ya gcig zhu ba'i don du spyan 'dren pa'i gros byas pas/ chos rje pas kyang 'thad gsungs nas/ bka' yig kyang bskur ba yin/ nged kyis kyang zhu yig nan bskur ba yin pa la 'byon du ma nyan/ chos rje pa bzhugs pa'i tshe byon na chos rje pa yang mnyes par yong bar 'dug

gal te sku gshegs na'ang khyed bzhugs na blo bde bsams nas spyan drangs pa lags | rkyen ci yin ni ma shes/ khyed ma byon pa de yin/ de la nged cung zad yi chad pa byung*/ da dung chos kyi rje ni mi bzhugs/ gzhan slob dpon med pas khyed la re che zhing mchis/ 'dul ba/ phar phyin/ tshad ma la sogs pa'i lung yang mang du len pa dang*/ chos kyi rje nyid sku gshegs khar/ khyed la dge slong zhig ma grub pa de blo ma bde/ gzhan yid la mi bde ba mi snang gsungs/ der nged spyan snga na yod pa rnams kyis de skad mi gsung bar zhus nas yun ring du bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig par zhu zhus pas/ de shin tu dka' gsungs nas ma gnang*/ 'o na gal te chos kyi rje zhal mi bzhugs na/ mkhan po su la zhu byas pas/ deng sang dbus gtsang khams gsum na slob dpon bsod nams seng ge las mkhas btsun 'dzom pa med/ khos shān+ti'i dod pher ba yin gsungs/ chos rje pa'i thugs kyis kyang dgongs nas 'dug pas/ chos rje pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i ched du 'byon par zhu/ gal te khyed ma byon na nga'i mkhan po 'os pa gzhan su mi snang bas/ tshe 'di la bsnyen rdzogs mi 'grub par snang*/ chos mang po'i lung yang mi thob par 'dug de khyed la rag lus pa yin/ da chos rje ni mi bzhugs/ khyed kho na la re zhing ltos pa yin/ thugs la thogs/ khyed byon na chos rje pa dang khyad par med pa'i 'du shes yod pa yin pas dam tshig la dgongs/ ngas zhus pa'i tshig 'di rnams la bcos ma dang*/ mi bden pa'i tshig gcig yod na'ang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje 'bar bas bdag gi snying tshal pa brgya ru 'gas pa yin/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams dpang du bzhugs pa yin/ gzhan yang zhu ba'i don 'ga' zhig tshigs su bcad de snyan du gsol pa// // bdag gi bla ma mya ngan 'das/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dbyings su zhig

/ye shes nyi ma nub par gyur/ /thugs rje'i sprin gyi phung po dengs/ /dam chos char gyi rgyun yang chad/ /kye ma bdag nyid skal ba dman/ /dman pa'i dbang gis 'di ltar snang | | snang bas khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ khyed kyi thugs rjes ma dgongs na// da ni bdag gi ston pa su/ /de ltar 'phrin du zhu ba'i tshe/ /bla ma'i yon tan dran pa dang | khyed dang yul gyis bskal pa yis/ /nyes pa dran nas mchi ma lhung*/ /bla ma'i bka' drin stobs dang ni/ khyed nyid kyis ni thugs rje dang*/ /bdag gi 'dun pa'i dbang gis ni/ /gsol ba'i don 'di 'grub par mdzod/ /de ltar zhus par mi dgongs na/ /ngo tsha gang yin khrims gang yin/ /dam tshig gang yin snying rje gang | | ngus shing bos nas gsol btab na/ /'brel med kyis kyang phan 'dogs na | khyed kyi snying rjes cis mi 'jug /'phrin yig 'di ni gzigs tsam gyis/ khyod sku rta mchog snying rje'i yid/ /lcag gis bskul nas brtson pa'i stobs/ /rlung gi shugs kyis 'dir gshegs shig /nged rang de na yar ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + 'ongs nas ) sa skyar phyag re tsam 'tshal ba dang*/ bsnyen rdzogs shig gi ched du yong bar spro ba lags mod | 'u cag gi 'dun ma'i rtsa ba 'di nas bsgrub dgos par snang bas ma 'ong pa yin | de khyed kyis phyogs mtha' dag nas sems par zhu/ lam yang rgyal khrims 'jags nas bgrod sla bar yod/ mdo khams ¡Ã ring mo ( ¡¶ zha ¡· sgang ril po ) rang re'i slob ma sha stag yin/ de thugs la yod pa gyis/ de'i rkyen dpon skam chu ba la mngag yod pas/ khong gis kyang zhabs tog tu gang 'gro byed de mchi/ yi ge'i rten dang 'dir 'byon pa'i mthun rkyen la/ rgyal po'i gnas nas phyung ba'i dngul bre chen gang la/ srang lnga bcu nga gsum byas pa zhig mchis/ rgya che ba ma 'dzom/ slad mar khyed 'dir byon nas rang re thams cad chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod kha na ma tho ba med pa la 'tshogs pa dang shin tu bkra shis par smon/

chu pho byi ba'i lo dpyid zla 'bring po'i ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + yar gyi ngo'i ) tshes gsum la ling chu rtser khab kyi gtsug lag khang du bris/ bde legs su gyur cig/ //༄༅/ /grags pa rin chen gyi zhus lan bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal mchog bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde snod 'dzin pa grags pa rin chen gyis/ /ji ltar dri ba byas pa de yi lan/ /mdo tsam bshad pa 'di la gus par nyon/ /de la thog mar sdom pa gsum gyi ngo bo'am/ mtshan nyid ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las ldog pa/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa/ byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du gzhan la gnod pa las ldog pa'i steng du/ sems can thams cad la phan pa bsgrub pa la zhugs pa/ sems pa rgyun chags pa can byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'o/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ 'bras bu sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i brtul zhugs la nye bar zhugs pa/ spong ba dang sgrub pa'i sems pa rgyun chags pa can/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin/ lung chos pa'i lugs kyis ngo bo dang mtshan nyid gcig tu 'dod pa lags/ gcig dang tha dad pa'i tshul ni/ nyan thos kyi lugs kyis so so thar pa'i sdom pa/ lus ngag la rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i tshul gyis gnas par 'dod/ theg pa chen po pa'i lugs kyis/ sems la bag chags dge ba'i tshul gyis bsgom par 'dod pa yin pas grub mtha' so so'i rjes su 'brangs nas brtsis na tha dad du 'ong ba yin/ theg pa chen po'i lugs kyis gzhal na/ nyan thos kyi sdom pa nyid kyang sems kyi khyad par gyi chos yin pas gnas pa'i tshe sems kyi ngo bo gcig la bag chags kyi tha dad du phye bar 'dod de/ de nyid dngos po'i gnas lugs su'ang go /nyan thos dang theg chen gyi sdom pa gnyis len pa'i tshul ci nas kyang tha dad/ byang chub sems dpa' dang gsang sngags kyi sdom pa rim gyis pa'i lugs la so sor thob/

cig car 'jug pa la cig car du 'jug pa thob pa'ang yod/ gtong ba'i tshe nyan thos kyi sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu phal cher gyis byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa mi gtong*/ sdom pa gong ma gnyis btang bas/ nyan thos kyi sdom pa mi gtong ba'i skabs kyang srid/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa btang bas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa mi gtong ba'i skabs kyang srid pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i dngos gzhi btang bas gsang sngags kyi sdom pa mi gtong mi srid/ byang chub kyi sems las 'das nas/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas/ rdo rje spun bsad pa lta bu la mthar thug grub pa'i tshe gsum ka dus gcig tu gtong ba yin/ mang po'i don du mi gcig bsad pa lta bus nyan thos kyi sdom pa btang yang*/ sdom pa gong ma gnyis po mi gtong ba'i steng du dge ba yar ldan du 'ong ba yin/ rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang du sbas pa'i rtsa

( ¡¶ zha ¡· + lnga ) mi 'du ba lags/ yan lag gi rlung lnga 'byung ba lnga'i ngo bo las mi 'da' ba'i phyir/ ngo bo'i cha nas rtsa ba'i rlung las gzhan ma yin/ gnas dang las kyi cha nas so sor bzhag pa yin/ dbang bskur ma thob pa la dril bu pa byed dus/ sngon du slob ma sbyong ba'i cho ga de/ dbang bskur rgyas pa'i sta gon gyi skabs kyi nang gi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga de lta bu byed pa lags/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba la bsre bslad bya ba'i gzhi/ rgyud mtshan nyid pa gcig yod pa'ang srid/ spyir rgyud kha 'thor ba'i lung mang po dang*/ mdo sde'i lung mang po bris 'dug pas thams cad bod kyis byas pa'ang ma yin/ mtshams sbyor dang lhan gcig tu mang po zhugs 'dug de'i rgyu mtshan gyi gtso bo badz+ra dhṛka la sogs pa'i sngags kyi btu ba rnams/ rgya gar gyi sbyor tshul rgyus med par bod kyi lugs su byas 'dug gzhan yang tshig gi sbyor ba rags po mang po gda'/ spyir rgyud yang dag pa dang*/ lhad med kyi bka' bstan bcos rnams la 'dris pa byas tsam na/ lhad can rnams skyon can du rjen cher 'ong rgyu cig mchi/ de ltar khyed kyis dris pa'i lan brjod pa'i/ /dge bas ma lus 'gro ba'i ma rtogs dang*/ /log rtog the tshom dra ba rnam bsal nas/ /shes bya'i gnas la blo gros rgyas gyur cig /me mo yos bu'i lo/ smin drug gi zla ba'i nyi shu bdun gyi nyin par 'dam gyi sa cha gad skya zhes bya bar/ 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// //'dis bstan pa rin po che dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ //༄༅/ /rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog skyong la bka' bsgo gnang ba bzhugs/ ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang | chos skyong ba rnams dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs las nye bar bskrun pa'i khye'u de'i ming*/

dharma pha la rak+ṣi ta zhes bya bar btags pa yin | 'di la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ mkhyen brtse ldan pa'i mkhyen brtse'i byin rlabs dang*/ /mthu stobs mchog gis mthu stobs nus mthu dang*/ /lhag bsam dag pas lhag bsam byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar gsol ba de ltar 'grub gyur cig /sa mo lug gi lo ston zla ra ba'i tshes bdun gyi snga dro'i cha la/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog skyong gi gur chen du bris pa'o// //phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ// //༄༅/ /gur mgon lcam dral gyi rjes gnang bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog ma kho nar mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong mnyes par byas nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ gang gi drin gyis dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku la sogs pa'i mthar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma dam pas bdag la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su gzhugade nas gnyis kas bla ma he ru kar dmigs la/ de'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas/ de'i thugs ka nas de nyid 'dra ba'i sku dpag tu med pa spraus nas slob ma'i lus la thim pas/ slob ma'ang de nyid kyi skur gyur cing lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyis g.yon logs su lha mo bskyed nas

| de la phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa thim par gnyis kar gyis bsam zhing*/ rtsa sngags drag tu brjod pa dang rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim zhing*/ de'i tha ma'i sngags kyi phreng ba phyir 'phros pas slob ma'i thugs kar zhugs nas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mtha' mar 'khod par bsam zhing*/ rol mo dang bcas pa'i drag sngags brjod/ sngags kyi rjes su bzlas pa lan gsum byed du gzhug slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gsum byed du gzhug slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim zhing*/ dai'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sa bon gyi rnam par gyur pa spraus nas/ slob ma'i khar zhugs te snying gar thims pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i phyag mtshan dang sa bon gyi rnam par char bzhin du bab pas/ slob ma'i snying la thim par bsam zhing*/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa'i drag sngags brjod par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ sa ma ya sma ra la sogs pas dam la bzhag cing*/ de nas gnyis kar gyis sngags thams cad lan gnyis su brjod nas/ bka' bsgo bar bya/ de nas slob mas yon phul zhing*/ mjug gi cho ga gzhan dang 'dra bar byas/ de ltar de yi rjes gnang gi /cho ga nyi mas rab bskul nas/ /blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal gyis sbyar/ /dge des 'gro kun dge legs shog /me mo yos bu'i lo smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nyin par 'dam gyi sa char bris pa'o// //༄༅/ /rgyal po go pe la sras dang btsun mor bcas la shing mo

yos sogs la gnang ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ na mo mañju gho ṣā ya/ dpal ldan sa gsum gsal mdzad pa/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid thams cad mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun skyob bla na med | | rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig mngon mtho'i bde ba dang | | rnam grol bde ba bsgrub pa'i gzhi/ /mi dbang mchog 'di brtan bya'i phyir// rab tu shis pa'i tshig 'di brjod/ /dbang chen chu gter lhun po dang*/ /nyi ma zla ba rin chen lha'i/ /lha khyod yun ring zhabs brtan zhing*/ /bzhed don ma lus kun grub shog /lhag bsam kun nas rnam dag cing*/ /skyod pa'i phrin las rgya che ba | | 'gro ba kun gyi rten gyur pa'i/ /sa chen khyod ni rgyal gyur cig /gting mtha' yas pa'i bsod nams chu/ /yon tan rin chen du mas gtams/ /blo gros klu dbang gis bsten pa'i/ /dpal ldan rgya mtsho rgyal gyur cig /rnam par dag pa'i rigs mtho zhing*/ /dpal 'byor dpag bsam shing gis brgyan/ /lha tshogs dkon mchog gus bsten pa/ /ri yi rgyal po rgyal gyur cig /dbang phyug brjed pa'i dkyil 'khor las/ /mthu stobs tsha zer rab 'phros pas/ /phas rgol mun pa'i tshogs 'joms pa/ /gsal byed khyod ni rgyal gyur cig /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba las/ /phan bde'i 'od zer rab bkye bas/ /dbul ba'i gdung ba sel byed pa/ /ri bong 'dzin khyod rgyal gyur cig /bsod nams rgya mtshor legs 'khrungs shing*/ /mdzes shing yid 'ong dag pa'i sku/ /bsten na dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba/ /yid bzhin nor bu rgyal gyur cig /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos rnams dang*/ /rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rgyal/ /srid las rnam rgyal bden pa'i mthus | | rgyal byed tshig 'di 'grub gyur cig /rgyal sras rgyal bar bya ba'i phyir/ / tshul 'di tshul khrims rnam dag cing*/ /blo gsal blo gros 'jigs med pa/ /chos 'dzin chos smra 'phags pas sbyar/

/rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' go pe la bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ shing mo yos kyi lo sar pa shar ba'i tshe sbyar ba'o// // ༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs par 'khrungs/ / ye shes bzhi yi rin chen las grub cing*/ /phrin las bzhi yi bang rim mdzes pa can | | rgyal ba lhun po'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag yid kyi chu gtsang las 'khrungs pa'i/ /sde sbyor spel legs snyan tshig ze'u 'bru can/ /dge legs bcud ldan me tog phreng ba 'dis/ /mi dbang sras dang btsun mor bcas rnams mchod/ / rdo rje lta bur rab tu mkhregs pa dang*/ /pad+ma rgyas pa lta bur mdangs gsal zhing | | lha yi lus ltar yid du 'ong ba dang*/ /rig pa 'dzin ltar rtag tu nad med cing | | nyi ma bzhin du gzi brjid phun sum tshogs/ /lnga po de yis khyod sku bde legs shog /ka la piṅka'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa dang*/ /drang srong mchog ltar rtag tu bden par smra/ /kun dga'i rnga ltar chos kyi sgra sgrogs shing*/ /dbang phyug lta bur tshig gi mchog rab grub/ /'brug gi sgra ltar sgra gzhan zil gyis gnon/ /lnga po de yis khyod gsung brgyan par shog /lhun po'i rgyal po lta bur brtan pa dang*/ /nam mkha' bzhin du shin tu rgya che zhing*/ /rgya mtsho lta bur rab tu zab pa dang*/ /dbyangs can lta bur blo mchog dang ldan zhing*/ /tshangs pa bzhin du tshad med bzhi dang ldan | | lnga po de yis khyod thugs bde legs shog /mi g.yo'i khams ltar shin tu tshe ring zhing*/ /lha yi bla ma lta bur yon tan ldan/ /rnam thos bu ltar 'byor pa phun sum tshogs/ /yid bzhin nor ltar 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong*/ /'khor los sgyur ltar phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ /lnga po de yis lha khyod 'byor par shog /tshogs can rab mchog lta bur tshul khrims dag /chos 'phags lta bur ting 'dzin mchog dang ldan/ /gsang bdag bzhin du mthu stobs rmad byung zhing*/

/spyan ras gzigs ltar snying rje'i ngang tshul can/ /'jam dbyangs lta bur mkhyen rab phun sum tshogs/ /lnga po de yis mgon khyod rgyal gyur cig /dpal ldan bla ma 'dren mchog bla na med/ /thub dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /dam chos nges par 'byung ba mchog gi lam/ /dge 'dun tshogs mchog lha mis mchod pa'i gnas/ / de dag kun gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji skad smon lam btab pa 'grub par shog /mi dbang rgyal sras dpal ldan go pe la/ /sras dang btsun mo phun sum tshogs bya'i phyir/ /smon lam bzang po dpal ldan 'phags pas sbyar/ /dge ba gang des rgyal sras rgyal gyur cig /rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' yab sras btsun mo dang bcas pa la/ smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag chos smra ba'i btsun pa 'phags pa zhes bya bas sbyar nas/ me pho 'brug gi lo sar pa shar ba'i tshe | bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir phul ba'o/ /smon lam gyi dngos gzhi rkang pa drug pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lags/ tshigs su bcad pa dgu mchis// // ༈ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpal gyi 'byung gnas srid gsum bla ma dngos grub gter/ /che ba'i che mchog lha mi rnams kyis gus btud pa/ /'phags pa'i gtso bo thub dbang de dang dam pa'i chos | | 'dus pa'i mchog gyur dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad dang snying brtse rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gsal zhing*/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag 'gro ba rnams kyi gnyen gcig po/ /bsod nams dbang phyug rgyal ba'i sras po go pe la/ /bde legs bya phyir rab tu shis pa'i tshig 'di brjod/ /bkra shis gang zhig ye shes rin chen las grub cing*/ /chos dbyings mkha' las legs par bshad pa'i 'od bkye bas/ /gdul bya'i pad+mo kun tu rgyas mdzad bla ma yi/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig tshogs gnyis dpal las byung gyur cing*/

/thub pa'i dbang po sku gsum dpal 'byor lhun gyis grub/ /rang gzhan don brnyes bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig rkang gnyis dbang pos legs gsungs shing*/ /thog mtha' bar dge rnam par dkar la ma 'dres pa/ /zhi ba chags bral nges par 'byin pa dam chos kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig kun mkhyen rgyal po'i rjes zhugs shing | | tshul khrims rnam dag yon tan rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /lha mi'i mchod gnas 'dus pa'i mchog gyur dge 'dun gyi/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis gang zhig mthu dang rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas shing | | brtse ba'i dbang gis 'jigs byed mi bzad skur bstan nas/ /bgegs tshogs kun 'joms rdo rje chos skyong thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /chos kyi rgyal po yon tan mthar phyin bden pa dang*// chos dbyings gang zhig 'dus ma byas pa'i bden pa dang*/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung sna tshogs mthu ldan bden pa yis/ /smon lam rnam dag ji skad btab bzhin 'grub par shog /rgyal ba'i sras po phyogs rnams kun nas rgyal bya'i phyir/ / phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po gang yin pas/ /bdag gis bsams bzhin legs par dgongs nas mgrin gcig tu/ /shis pa'i dbyangs sgra rnam kun mchog ldan sgrogs par shog /de skad smra de shākya'i brtul zhugs legs 'dzin pa// blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal ldan bzang po zhes bya yis/ /lto 'phye'i dbang po'i gcig pa'i gcig la legs sbyar nas/ /mi yi dbang po go pe la la phul ba'o// // ༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo | | bkra shis las byung bkra shis kyis 'phags shing*/ /bkra shis lhun grub bkra shis ngang tshul can/ /bkra shis mdzad pas bkra shis legs bsgrub pa/

/ bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir rgyal/ /dpal ldan bkra shis dam pas yongs bzung zhing*/ /dpal 'byor bkra shis rmad byung 'od zer gyis/ /dpal gzhan zil gnon bkra shis rgyal byed pa/ /dpal khyod bkra shis du mas rgyal gyur cig /rgyal ba kun gyi bkra shis gcig bsdus pa/ /chos rje rtag pa'i bkra shis gdul bya'i dpal/ /srid zhi'i bkra shis rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bkra shis yid 'ong dpal gyi sku mnga' ba/ /gsung dbyangs bkra shis yan lag drug cus brgyan/ /bkra shis mi 'gyur bde chen rol pa'i thugs/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog | gang zhig thos pas thog mar bkra shis shing*/ /nye bar bsams na gnas skabs bkra shis la/ /bsgoms na rtag pa'i bkra shis lhun grub pa/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshul khrims rnam dag bkra shis gzhi brtan zhing | | yon tan rin chen bkra shis gter gyis phyug /brtul zhugs bzang po'i bkra shis stobs 'chang ba/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / bkra shis 'od 'bar rin chen las grub pa'i/ /bkra shis rgya mtsho rgyal bas bstan pa yi/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho bkra shis dge mtshan can/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'dod rgu'i bkra shis dpal gyis 'byor gyur zhing*/ /skye rgu'i bkra shis byed pa 'jig rten rje/ /lha yi mchog dang klu dbang bkra shis gang

| | bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bkra shis shog /bkra shis mchog gi bkra shis legs brjod pa'i/ /bkra shis de yis lha khyod bkra shis shing*/ /phyogs rnams dus kun shin tu bkra shis gang*/ /bzhed bzhin bkra shis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal sras bkra shis du mas rgyal bya'i phyir/ /bkra shis rmad byung bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung*/ /dam pa'i chos kyi bkra shis kyis mdzes pa/ / 'phags pa zhes byas bkra shis rnam par spel/ /rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' go pe la yab sras btsun mo dang bcas pa bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bkra shis kyi phreng ba rnam par spel ba zhes bya ba/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa 'phags pas nye bar bsdebs nas/ sa phau rta'i lo sar pa shar ba'i tshe phul ba'o// // ༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i bkra shis bkra shis kyi dbang po zhes bya ba/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo | | gang gi zhabs pad ze'u 'bru'i phreng ldan lha dang lha min klu dbang gis/ / kun nas dga' ba'i gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer dra bas cher gsal zhing*/ / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbus na legs bshad seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa | | rgyal ba'i dbang po skye rgu'i sgron ma'i gsung rab dri med phyogs bcur rgyal/ / bkra shis rgya mtsho yon tan nor bu'i gter mnga' ba/ /gang gi dbang gis dbang phyug dam pa'i mchog gyur de'i/ /bkra shis rmad byung snyan ngag ngag gis legs brjod kyis/ /'byung po gang dag phyogs 'dir lhags rnams gus pas nyon/ /gang gi zhing khams dri med 'dod yon bgrang yas shing*/ /'phags mchog rnams dang 'gro bzangs dbang pos legs bsten pas/ /yon tan dpag tu med ces bya ba'i zhing khams kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bdud bzhi las rgyal phun sum tshogs brnyes de bzhin gshegs/

/dgra bcom dbang po yang dag rdzogs pa rnam sangs rgyas/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med ldan rnam nges pa | | gzi brjid rgyal po'i bkra shis dam pas bde legs shog /gang gi 'od kyis zhing gi khyon kun gsal byed cing*/ /mtshan gyi dpal dang dpe byad bzang pos rnam par spras/ /pad+ma rā ga'i ri bo lta bur brjid pa'i sku'i/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshangs dbang dri za'i glu yis nye bar bskrun min pa'i/ /gsung dbyangs rnam dag yan lag drug cus rab brgyan pa'i/ / dri med chos char rgya cher rab 'bebs gsung mchog gi /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gdod nas rnam dag nyes tshogs tshang tshing nyer zhi zhing*/ /gzungs dang ting 'dzin mngon par shes pas mngon par rtsen/ / gzigs pa sgrib med thugs rjes rol pa'i thugs mnga' ba'i/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'gyur med tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med mnga' zhing*/ /yon tan rin chen phrin las gsal ba'i 'od rab 'byin/ /tshe yi dpal dang ye shes dam pa'i mchog stsol ba'i/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gsang sngags gang gis 'gro ba'i tshe 'dzin 'byor pa'i dpal | | yid la 'dod rgu kun nas legs bsgrubs phun tshogs kyi/ /pha rol phyin byed gsung gi gsang ba legs bsdus pa'i/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /'gro ba'i rtsa lag gzhan don dgyes pa'i ngang tshul can/ / rab tu dga' sogs sa bcu rnams la legs gnas pa'i/ /rgyal sras rnams dang rdul bral dgra bcom tshogs rnams kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gang gis phrin las dge bas legs bsdus lha mchog dang*/ / grub pa rig 'dzin lha min mi dang klu dbang sogs/ /dpal 'byor gnyis kyi bde la dga' mgur longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/rgyal ba'i dbang po tshe dang ye shes dpag med pa'i/ /gsang sngags dbang po 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor zhing bcas kyi/ /bkra shis dbang po snyan ngag ngag gis legs spel nas/ /mi yi dbang po dpal dang ldan la 'phags pas 'bul | | tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i bkra shis bkra shis kyi dbang po zhes bya ba | lcags mo bya'i lo sar pa tshes pa'i tshe/ 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// // ༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ 'gro ba'i bla ma yon tan rin chen gter/ /snyan pa'i 'od kyis sa gsum rab gsal ba'i/ /zhabs pad dri med spyi bos blangs byas nas/ / mchog tu shis par byed pa'i tshig 'di brjod/ /nad med pa dang tshe ring 'byor/ / dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /zhi ba'i ting 'dzin shes rab ste/ /drug po'i bkra shis gang lags pa/ /mkha' dang lhun po rgya mtsho dang*/ /nyi ma zla ba yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu'i dpe dang rab mtshungs pa/ /kun nas shis par 'gyur ba gson | | rang gi mngon par 'du byed rnam spangs shing*/ /'du ba'i rdul gyis kun nas ma gos la/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi rkyen gyis mi rdzi ba/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag tu nad med shog /gdod nas legs par bshad pa'i lhun sdug cing*/ /log par sgrub pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo la/ /mi nub mi 'gyur bskal pa'i bar gnas pa | | lhun po ji bzhin tshe yang brtan gyur cig /zab cing rgya che'i 'byor pa mi zad pa | | ma lus skye rgu'i nyer 'tsho nyid gyur cing*/ /sna tshogs phan bde'i chu 'dzin rab 'byin pa/ /rgya mtsho ji bzhin 'byor pas 'byor gyur cig /rgol ba ngan pa'i smag rum rab 'joms shing*/ /'gran zla ri bong 'dzin pa'i gzi bcom nas/ / snyan pa'i 'od zer phreng bas lham me ba/ /nyi ma ji bzhin dbang phyug phun tshogs shog | kun rtog dra ba'i grwa zur nyer zhi zhing*/ /zag med bde ba dam pa'i ngang bsil ba/ /rtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rgyas gyur pa/ /zla rgyas ji bzhin ting 'dzin gyis zhir gyur/

/tshul dang tshul min 'byed pa'i 'od 'byin cing*/ /srid dang zhi ba'i dgos 'dod kun sgrub pa/ /bla na med pa'i rgyan gyi mchog gyur pa/ / rin chen ji bzhin shes rab mtshungs med shog /mngon mtho'i yan lag gnas yan lag /don kun grub pa'i yan lag ste/ /bzhi dang gcig gcig go rim bzhin | khyod la shis par 'gyur ba lags/ /shis par byed pa'i tshigs su bcad pa | yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba 'di/ chu pho khyi'i lo sar pa shar ba'i tshe/ 'phags pas sbyar nas mi'i dbang po la phul ba'o// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bde legs rgya mtsho dkon mchog rin chen la/ /dad pa rgya mtsho'i 'dun pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /skye rgu rgya mtsho'i dpal du gyur ba la/ /bkra shis rgya mtsho'i shis pa brjod par bya/ /dpal 'byor rgya mtsho yon tan nor bu'i gter/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes gcig bsdus pa/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ / bkra shis rgya mtshos deng 'dir bkra shis shog /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal las 'khrungs gyur cing*/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gting mtha' rab yangs pa/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis rgya mtshos deng 'dir bkra shis shog /gsung rab rgya mtsho rtogs pa dam pa yi/ /rin chen rgya mtsho'i gter kyi rten gyur pa/ /dam chos rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis rgya mtsho deng 'dir bkra shis shog /'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshul khrims gzhi brtan zhing*/ /yon tan rgya mtsho skye rgu'i nyer 'tsho mchog /dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis rgya mtshos deng 'dir bkra shis shog / bkra shis rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs legs bsgrags pas/ /sku tshe rgya mtsho bzhin du brtan pa dang*/ /dpal 'byor rgya mtsho che ltar rgya che zhing*/ /bstan pa'i rgya mtsho rnam par rgyas byed shog /mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i zhabs la legs gtugs shing*/

/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i nor gyis phyug gyur pa/ /blo gros rgya mtsho rgyal mtshan dpal zhes pas | | bkra shis rgya mtsho mchog 'di rnam par bskyil/ /'di ni bkra shis rgya mtsho ste | | de nyid bstod tshig rgya mtsho'ang yin/ /blo gsal rgya mtsho'i yid 'phrog pas/ / snyan ngag rgya mtsho'ang 'di nyid yin/ /rgyal po rgyal khams dang bcas pa bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis kyi rgya mtsho rnam par bskyil ba zhes bya ba 'di/ chu mo phag gi lo sar pa shar ba'i tshe bsdebs nas phul ba'o// //༈ na mo gu ru rat+na tra yā ya/ gang mnyes na n-i+i rgyal ba kun mnyes shing*/ / de mnyes na ni dngos grub kun 'byung ba/ /bla ma dam pa brgyud par bcas rnams kyi | | bkra shis dam pa khyed la sbyin gyur cig /de nyid gzigs pas srid las rnam grol zhing*/ /thugs rje chen pos zhi la mi gnas pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa khyed la sbyin gyur cig /chags pa med pas chags bral du byed cing*/ /bgrod pa gcig lam zab mo nyer zhi ba/ /dam chos rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa khyod la sbyin gyur cig | tshul gnas thos dang ting nge 'dzin brtson pas/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtshor mngon gzhol ba/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi/ / bkra shis dam pa khyed la sbyin gyur cig /lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin drang srong dang | | klu dang lha min gnod sbyin dri za sogs/ /bde 'gro'i dbang po'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa khyod la sbyin gyur cig /sa chu me rlung nyi zla rin chen dang*/ /bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang sman la sogs/ /'byung dang 'byung ba las gyur thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa khyed la sbyin gyur cig khyad par 'phags pa'i bkra shis yid 'ong ba/ /bsam pa dge bas shis pa brjod pa yis | | sras bcas rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams kun gyis kyang*/

/'di yi mthun 'gyur kun nas gsung gyur cig /shing pho byi ba'i lo 'di lo rnams kyi/ /thog ma yin zhes gtsug lag dag las 'byung*/ /'di nyid nas brtsams mi dbang yum sras bcas | | bde legs bya phyir bdag gis de skad brjod/ /rgyal po chen po sras dang | btsun mo dang*/ rgyal brgyud dang*/ rgyal srid dang bcas pa thams cad bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ shing pho byi ba'i lo sar pa shar ba'i tshe/ dga' ston gyi kun dga' ra bar/ bkra shis kyi dbyangs kun nas bsgrags pa'i don du/ 'phags pas nye bar bsdebs nas rgyang ring po nas bskur ba'o// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / byang chub sems kyi rin chen las 'khrungs shing*/ /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis bskrun gyur pas/ /don gnyis brnyes pa'i phrin las grub pa yi/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /srid zhi'i rlung gis rnam par mi bskyod pa'i/ / chos dbyings ye shes pha rol son gyur nas/ /phrin las rdo rje bdud dpung nges 'joms pa'i/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /'tshe ba med pa phan bde'i ngang tshul la/ /gcig tu goms pa'i brtul zhugs mthar phyin pas/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med legs brnyes pa'i/ /tshe dpag med pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog | dam chos bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba dpag yas kyis/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i thabs brtson pas/ /skye rgu'i gnyen gcig sman pa'i blar gyur pa'i/ /sman gyi bla ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyi | | thugs rje bsdus pa'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba/ /phrin las chen po 'gag med rol pa can/ /thugs rje chen po'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /'gro la byams pas byams pa'i ngang tshul can/ /brtson pa dam pas kun nas ma pham zhing*/ / phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor ba/

/byams mgon rgyal ba'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /'gro ba sgrol mdzad sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ /rme brtsegs 'chol pa rta mchog la sogs pa'i/ /lha dang lha mo khro bo khro mo'i tshogs/ /'phags pa'i rnam 'phrul rnam par bkod rnams dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba che ba'i cher grags pa/ /go 'phang sna tshogs tshul yang sna tshogs shing*/ /bstan la dga' bas bstan pa rab bsrung ba'i/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i pho brang lha sa'i gzhal med kyi/ /thub pa'i dbang po sras dang slob ma dang*/ / 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis spel ba 'di/ /rgyal po khyod la 'phags pas ring nas 'bul/ /shing mo glang gi lo sar pa shar ba'i tshe bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ bod kyi sprul pa'i rgyal po mang po byon pa'i gnas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phel ba'i gzhi/ dpal lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di nye bar spel nas bskur ba'o// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ na maḥ shrī mā na pa ra ma gu ru tsa ra naṃ ka ma lā ya/ he ru ka dpal ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs/ /rje btsun grags pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug sogs/ /bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rnam gzigs gtsug tor can dang thams cad skyob/ / 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srungs dpal/ /shākya thub sogs phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /mdo yi sde dang 'dul ba ma mo dang*/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang de rtogs pa'i/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog / tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pas mdzes rnams dang*/ /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong pa dang phyi mi 'ong*/ /dgra bcom rang rgyal rgyal sras thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /dbyangs dang gsal byed brjod pa kun gyi

gzhi | | de dag las btus gsang sngags rig sngags dang*/ /gzungs sngags snying po nye ba'i snying po sogs/ /skul byed sngags kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma rin chen dang*/ /sna tshogs rdo rje ral gri ut+pal sogs/ /don chen mtshon byed phyag mtshan thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog | stug po'i zhing dang mi mjed bde ba can/ /mngon par dga' dang yon tan dpag med sogs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bstan pa'i zhing khams kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /rdo rje chos skyong ba dang phyogs skyaung dang*/ / lha dbang klu dbang gnod sbyin lha min dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba che ba'i che rnams kyi | | bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /yid bzhin nor bu bum bzang dpag bsam shing*/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang grub pa'i ral gri dang*/ /rdzogs ldan sprin tshogs 'dod rgu sbyin byed pa'i/ /rdzas mchog rnams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /sa dang chu rlung me dang nyi zla dang*/ sman dang lo tog bsam gtan la sogs pa/ /'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor gyur pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bde legs shog /de ltar gsung rab rin chen gling las shis pa'i tshig gi nor bu'i tshogs/ /blo gros ded dpon dam pas blangs gang rnam dpyod rdo rjes phug rjes su/ /ngag gi srad bus nye bar brgyud pa bde legs gsal ba'i 'od 'byin pa'i/ /bkra shis rin chen phreng ba 'di ni mi dbang nyid la 'phags pas 'bul

| | me pho stag gi lo sar pa shar ba bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ /bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di dpal sa skyar rnam par spel nas/ /dbang phyug dam pa'i phyag tu 'phags pas ring nas bskur ba'o// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur cing*/ / sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba/ /bla ma'i bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig | shar gyi ri rtser skye rgu'i sgron ma'i dpal/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'bar bas lhang nge ltar/ /yon tan phrin las 'od stong 'bar ba po/ /rgyal pa'i bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /rgyu skar khrod na rgyu skar bdag po'i dpal/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mdzes pa ltar/ /chags bral chags pa sel ba'i 'od 'byin pa | | chos kyi bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /rgya mtsho'i gling na sna tshogs rin chen gyis/ /rgya mtsho'i rgyal po kun nas 'byor pa ltar/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor gyis 'byor par gang gyur pa/ /tshogs kyi bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /skyabs gsum rin chen cod pan gyis mdzes shing*/ /bslab gsum rin chen dra ba'i rgyan gyis spras/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i sgron ma mchog gyur pa/ /bshes gnyen rnams kyi bkra shis sbyin gyur cig /de ltar bkra shis dam pa las byung zhing*/ /bkra shis ngo mtshar rmad kyis phul gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis brjod pas dpal du 'os pa khyod/ / rtag tu 'gro ba kun gyi dpal gyur cig khyod kyi dpal gyi gzi yis phyogs kyi khongs | | rgya mtsho'i chu yis sa yi khyon lta bur/ khyab par byas nas 'byung po thams cad kyi/ /rtag tu nye bar 'tsho ba nyid gyur cig /gling bzhir bcas pa'i rgya mtsho'i rgya khyon ni/ khor yug ri yis kun nas bcings pa ltar/ /lha yi dpal dang bcas pa'i rgyal srid kyang*/

/sangs rgyas mthu yis kun nas srung gyur cig /bkra shis 'di ni dpal gyi 'byung gnas te/ /sdeb sbyor byed pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ / bzang po nyid lags lo sar bde legs phyir/ /dbang phyug dam pa'i dpal la gus pas 'bul/ /lo gsar 'di ni me mo yos lags te/ /'phags pa'i yul du rab byung zhes byar grags/ /rab byung 'di ni lo yi thog ma ste/ /'di nas brtsams te kun tu bde legs shog /me mo yos bu'i lo sar pa shar ba'i tshe bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa spel nas mi'i dbang po'i phyag tu bskur ba'o// // ༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa rgya che zhing*/ /ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i ye shes rab zab la | | dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje kun 'jug pa/ /bla ma mchog la btud nas shis pa brjod/ /gang las phan bde'i dpal 'byor kun 'byung zhing*/ /srid zhi'i nyes pa ma lus drungs 'byin pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mdzad pa legs bsgrub pa | | mtshungs med bla ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /byang chub lam gyis byang chub brnyes gyur cing*/ /kun dga'i chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed mdzad pa/ /rkang gnyis dbang po zla gnyis mi mnga' ba/ /rgyal ba'i bkra shis dam pas rgyal gyur cig | gsung rab dam pa dam pa las brgyud cing*/ /rtogs pa dge ba dge ba'i 'byung gnas mchog /zhi mdzad zhi bar gyur pa dam chos kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /dam pas dam pa'i lam la zhugs gyur cing*/ /dge bas dge ba'i go 'phang mchog bsgrub par/ /gcig tu 'dun pa'i 'dun pa rnam dag pa/ /tshogs kyi bkra shis dam pas bkra shis shog /chos dang dam chos 'dzin pa gang yin pa/ /de dag skyong zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes nas/ /sgrub po'i 'dod don ma lus sgrub mdzad pa/ /chos skyong rnams kyis kun nas skyong gyur cig

/ 'jig rten skyong ba 'jig rten don gnyer zhing*/ /che ba'i che bar kun la grags gyur la/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul can/ /'jig rten skyong bas lhag par skyong gyur cig /rgyal po sras dang btsun mo sring bcas rnams/ /rgyal bar bya phyir 'phags pa'i blo gros las/ /rgyal ba'i gsung gi tshul dang rjes mthun par | | rgyal bar byed pa'i shis pa 'di byung ngo*/ /sa pho 'brug gi lo sar pa shar ba'i tshe bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis rnam par spel nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag sbyar nas/ rgyal po yab yum sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar bskur ba 'di ni ¡Ã sa pho 'brug gi ( ¡¶ zha ¡· me mo yos bu'i ) lo smal po'i zla ba la 'dam gyi sa'i char bris pa phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba gang zhig 'od dang dpal yon gyi/ /'byung gnas dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal nas | | phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam pa sel ba yi/ /bkra shis dam pa 'di ni brjod par bya/ /mi mjed zhes bya'i 'jig rten khams kyi mgon/ /dpal dang ldan zhing brtse ba chen po pa/ /skyob pa shākya thub pa zhes bya ba'i/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /shar gyi phyogs kyi rgyal ba'i zhing khams ni/ /nyon mongs thams cad bskyod par gang bzhugs pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes spyad ces bya ba'i/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /lho phyogs mun pa mun nag tshogs bcom par/ /dang po sems bskyed yid mdzad rnam grags pa/ / bsnyengs bral mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po yi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /nub kyi phyogs kyi thub pa'i zhing khams ni/ /kun nas yul phebs zhes bya'i chos kyi rgyal/ /thub pa 'khon dang rgyags pa rnam gnon pa'i/ / bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /byang gi phyogs na rnam par gnas pa'i zhing*/

/sangs rgyas rnams kyi spobs pa can zhes bya/ /thub pa rin chen gzugs bkod 'od gnon gyi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog/ byang shar 'jig rten bdud kyi sde bcom par/ /byang chub shing dbang drung du rnam 'phrul ba/ /bdud dang yid gnyis kun 'joms rnam gnon pa'i/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /shar lho'i 'jig rten rtag tu snang ba ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang po sems bskyed pas/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo 'byung dpal gyi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /lho nub phyogs na gnas pa'i 'jig rten khams/ /gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon// rin chen gdugs 'phags snang zhes bya ba yi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /nub byang mtshams su bkod pa thub pa'i zhing*/ /yongs dag rab gnas mngon 'phags zhes bya bar/ /rgyal ba byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba yi | | bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /steng gi 'jig rten dmigs pa med pa'i don/ /yid la byed pa can du skrag med pa/ /mun bral ting 'dzin mngon 'phags rgyal po yi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /'og gi zhing khams yon tan thams cad kyis/ /brgyan par dang po sems bskyed the tshom kun/ /gcod mdzad nyon mongs bskyod ces bya ba yi/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /gang sngon mtshan mchog 'di dag thos gyur pa'i/ /srog chags stong du tshang ba de dag kun/ /gaṅgā klung gi bye snyed tshe rabs su/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal rgyas thob pa'i mthar/ /bskal pa gcig la zhing khams gcig nyid du/ /rim gyis sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba ni/ /dag pa'i spyan gyis brgyan pa zhes bya'o/ /de dag kun gyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gzhan yang dus gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /thub pa'i dbang po sras dang slob mar bcas | | chos dang dpal dang 'od kyis lham me ba/

/de dag kun gyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /bkra shis mchog gi kun nas shis gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis dam pa'i shis pa brjod pa 'di/ /bkra shis du mas kun nas 'byor gyur pa/ / bkra shis brtan pa nyid la 'bul zhing mchis/ /rgyal po chen po/ sras dang*/ btsun mo/ srid 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di/ 'phags pas bsdebs nas sa mo sbrul gyi lo sar pa shar ba'i tshe phul ba'o// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis kun gyis bkra shis pa/ /bkra shis 'byung gnas la btud de/ /bkra shis kun gyis shis bya'i phyir/ /bkra shis rnam par spel ba brjod/ /dag snang yul gyi pho brang du/ /skal ba bzhin du snang gyur cing*/ /mos pa ji bzhin 'dren mdzad pa'i | | bla ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rdo rje 'chang dpal bdag med ma/ / bir+wa kṛṣ+ṇa ḍa ma pa/ /gnyis spangs ga ya dha ra dpal/ /shākya ye shes kun rig dang | | chos 'bar rje btsun snying po'i zhabs/ /rtse mo'i zhabs dang rgyal mtshan mtha' | | chos rje bzang po'i zhabs sogs kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog | chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du/ /gnyis med dag pa gnyis ldan zhing*/ / dus gsum rgyal ba kun bskyed pa'i/ /chos sku'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog / 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ /brjod du med cing bgrang du med/ /rnam dbye med pa'i chos nyid can/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ /bde chen nges pa lnga ldan zhing*/ /chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pa'i | | bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /bsam mi khyab pa'i gnas brnyes kyang | | sngon las rjes su 'brang ba'i phyir/ /rgyu yi rgyud grangs ji snyed pa/ /de snyed rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sna tshogs bkod pa'i zhing khams su/

/sna tshogs rnam par 'phrul ba yi/ /sna tshogs pa yis don mdzad pa'i/ /sprul sku'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /longs spyod rdzogs pa gcig las kyang*/ /gnas yul dus dang rnam pa yis/ /rnam pa du mar rab snang ba/ /sprul pa mang po'i bkra shis shog /rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob/ /'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub dang*/ / 'od srungs shākya thub mchog dpal/ /byams pa seng ge rab gsal sogs/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs gyur pa'i | | rkang gnyis gtso bo thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog / rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen 'byung*/ /dpag med don yod grub la sogs/ / dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtsor gyur pa/ /sprul pa mchog gi bkra shis shog /rdo rje rin chen chos dang ni/ /las kyi sems ma la sogs pa/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs su gang gnas nas/ /rgyal ba mnyes par byed pa dang*/ /gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi/ /gtso mo nyid du gang gyur pa/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo thams cad kyi/ / bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /byams pa sa yi snying po dang*/ /sgrib pa rnam sel kun tu bzang*/ /phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ /nam mkha'i snying po 'jam dbyangs sogs/ /sems dpa' mchog gi tshul bzung dang*/ /rang gi sa la gnas pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog | sgeg mo phreng ba glu ma gar/ /bdug spos me tog mar me ma/ /dri chab ma sogs mchod pa yi/ /lha mo rnams kyi bkra shis shog /gshin rje mthar byed shes mthar byed/ /pad+ma mthar byed bgegs mthar byed/ /mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon can/ /stobs chen gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur/ /hūm̐ mdzad la sogs khro bo yi | | rgyal po rnams kyi bkra shis shog /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dang*/ / rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa'i/ /pho nya mngag pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog

/gdung ba rnam sel yid myur sogs/ /bse ru rwa yi tshul 'dzin dang | | de bzhin tshogs na spyod pa yi/ /rang rgyal rnams kyi bkra shis shog /kauṇ+ḍi n+ya 'od srungs dang*/ /shā ri'i bu dang maud gal sogs/ /dgra bcom dbang po thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /'dod par lan cig phyir 'ong dang*/ /gang dag phyir mi 'ong ba dang*/ /rgyun zhugs de dag zhugs pa dang*/ / 'bras bur gnas pas phye ba ste/ / 'phags pa'i gang zag brgyad rnams kyi/ / bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /rdo rje nag po chen po dang*/ /dpal gyi lha mo la sogs pa/ /chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog | phyogs skyong ba dang lha chen dang*/ / klu dbang gza' dang rgyu skar sogs/ / 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /de ltar bkra shis rnam par spel ba 'di/ /sa bdag sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams | | dge bar bya phyir lcags pho rta yi lo/ /sar pa shar tshe 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar/ /phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid gzigs pa sgrib med pa'i/ /chos kyi spyan dang ldan rnams la/ /chos kyi tshul bzhin phyag 'tshal nas/ /chos bzhin shis pa brjod par bya/ /chos kyi dbang phyug kun rang bzhin/ /chos kyi dpal gyis 'byor gyur zhing*/ /chos las skyes pa kun skyed pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i bkra shis shog /chos kyi dbyings las byung gyur zhing*/ / chos nyid zab mos rab phye bas/ /chos kyi mnga' bdag mchog gyur pa/ /chos mdzad rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos kyi 'byung gnas las byung ba'i/ /chos don phun sum tshogs gyur pas/ /chos min rnam par sun 'byin pa'i/ /chos kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /chos rjes 'brang ba'i yid ldan pa/ /chos kyi rje yis rjes bskyangs pas/ /chos kyi rgya mtshor nyer zhugs pa/

/chos ldan rnams kyi bkra shis shog | chos kyi mnga' dbang brnyes pa gang*/ /chos kyi rgyal por rab bsgos nas/ / chos dang chos 'dzin kun srung ba/ /chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos lam dge ba spyad pa yis/ /chos tshul mngon par mthong ba yi/ /chos ldan 'jig rten skyong ba yis/ /chos bzhin bkra shis sbyin gyur cig /chos dbyings spros las rnam grol yang*/ /chos can sna tshogs kun snang ba/ /chos rnam gnyis kyi bden pa'i mthus | | chos tshul 'gro la gsal gyur cig /chos dang chos nyid ji snyed don rnams ji bzhin gang gis thugs chud pas/ /chos dang chos min rnam dbye'i phyogs la shin tu mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can/ /chos rje chos rgyal sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i 'od zer gsal ldan pa'i/ /chos drin chos bzhin nye bar thob pa'i chos 'dzin 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar/ /'di yi tshig dang de bzhin don gnyis ka /chos kyi tshul yin gzhan yang de bzhin du/ /chos nyid zab mo'i sgo la 'jug byed pas/ / bkra shis 'di ni chos kyi rgya mtsho yin/ /gang dag gis ni shis pa 'di brjod dang*// 'di yis gang la shis pa byas gyur pa/ /de dag bkra shis rgya mtsho'i dge mtshan gyis

| | kun nas shis par 'gyur ba snyam du'ang bsam/ /lcags mo lug gi lo nas brtsams nas su/ /lo rnams thams cad kun nas shis bya'i phyir/ /bdag gis bkra shis nye bar brjod 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs kyis mthun gyur brjod gyur cig /lcags mo lug gi lo sar pa shar ba bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnam par spel nas rgyal po chen po la phul ba'o/ / phyogs dang dus thams cad du shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig/ //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa 'od dang rdzu 'phrul chen po pa/ /mngon par shes pa sgrib pa med pa po/ /mi 'gyur mi 'gag rgyun mi 'chad pa can/ /sangs rgyas bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig | mtshan dang mthun pa'i dpe byad rab 'bar zhing*/ /don dang mthun pa'i tshig 'bru rnam dag pa/ /mkhyen dang mthun pa'i brtse ba chen po pa/ /sangs rgyas bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /nam mkha' ji bzhin 'jig rten mtha' yas shing | | 'jig rten ji bzhin sems can bgrang yas la/ /de bzhin phrin las pha mtha' yas pa po/ /sangs rgyas bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /mngon par mtho dang nges par 'byin pa'i lam/ /ngag tshig dri med seng ge'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ / bsnyems bral kun tu rnam par bsgrags pa yi/ /chos kyi bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /brtul zhugs bzang po thos pa'i nor ldan dang*/ /de bzhin 'phags pa'i gang zag brgyad rnams dang*/ /rgyal sras rgyal ba'i rgya mtshor nyer gzhol ba/ / dge 'dun bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /rdo rje chos skyong chos kyi gzi yis lham | | 'jig rten skyong ba 'jig rten dpal dang ldan/ /drang srong drang pos brtul zhugs ldan rnams kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas skye rgu bkra shis shog /sa chu me rlung nyi ma zla ba dang*/ /nor bu dpag bsam shing dang bum bzang dang*/ /sngags dang sman gyi dge ba'i mthu rnams kyis/

/snod dang bcas pa'i skye rgu bde legs shog /chu pho spre'u'i lo sar pa shar ba'i tshe bkra shis par bya ba'i don du bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag rnam par spel nas/ rgyal po chen po btsun mo sras dang bcas pa la/ 'phags pas phul ba 'di ni lcags mo lug gi lo/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin par shing kun gyi mkhar du sbyar ba'o// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma dang*/ /skyabs mchog dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rgyal po rgyal srid bcas pa bde legs phyir/ /bkra shis rnam par brjod pa 'di la gson/ /gnyis med ye shes rgya mtshor nyer 'khrungs shing*/ /chos dbyings gzigs pa sgrib pa med pa can/ /sbyin pa dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor ba/ /rab dga'i sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /sgo gsum dge ba'i spyod pa lhun grub pas/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i brtul zhugs bzang ldan zhing*/ /tshul khrims dag pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor ba/ /dri med sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho nyer bzung nas/ /lung gi chos kyi 'od 'bum 'gyed mdzad cing*/ /bzod pa dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor ba/ / 'od byed sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /rtogs pa dam pa'i ye shes me 'bar bas | | nyes tshogs tshang tshing kun nas sreg byed cing*/ /brtson 'grus dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor ba/ /'od 'phro'i sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /byang chub spyod pa shin tu rmad byung bas/ /rang gi gdul bya yongs su smin byed cing*/ /bsam gtan dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor ba/ /sbyang dka'i sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog | yang dag shes pas zhi ba mngon gyur kyang*/ /brtse ba chen pos 'gro la rjes chags shing*/ /shes rab dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor ba/ /mngon gyur sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /'khor ba'i chos las ring du 'phags gyur cing*/

/ rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtshor nyer gzhol ba/ /yang dag thabs kyi tshul la dbang 'byor ba/ /ring song sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /mnyam pa nyid du mngon par byang chub nas/ /srid zhi'i rtog pas rnam par mi bsgul zhing*/ smon lam dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor ba/ /mi g.yo'i sa la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /so so yang dag rig pa bzhi brnyes nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo kun nas legs bskor zhing | | stobs mchog dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor ba/ /blo gros legs par gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes nas/ / 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur legs thob cing*/ /ye shes dam pa'i tshul la dbang 'byor ba/ /chos kyi sprin la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /rdo rje lta bu'i rdo rje'i thugs brnyes nas/ /gnyis su med pas gnyis la legs bzhugs pa/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdzogs pa'i dpal mnga' ba'i/ /bkra shis dam pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /de ltar bkra shis rnam par spel ba 'dis/ /mi dbang sras dang srid sder bcas pa kun/ /chu mo bya yi lo la brtsams nas kyang*/ /shis par bya phyir 'phags pas rnam par spel/ 'di shing kun du// //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa la dbang ba mi yi rje/ /sras dang de dag btsun mor bcas | | rgyud bcas 'bangs dang bcas rnams la/ /bkra shis dam pa gsol bar bgyi/ /rang rigs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su/ /gang gi mthu yis mngon byed pa | | bla ma dam pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig/phyogs bcu dag gi zhing rnams na/ /dus gsum du ni bzhugs gyur pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /de dag kun gyi gsung rab dang*/ /de don bsgoms pas kun chub pa/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i chos rnams kyi/ /bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /rkang gnyis gtso bo'i dbang rnams kyi

| | thugs dang chos las 'khrungs gyur pa/ /sras dang slob ma'i tshogs rnams kyi | | bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /chos skyong chos kyi gzi yis lham/ /chos min rnam par sun 'byin pa/ /rdo rje chos skyong thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /grub pa rig 'dzin lha yi rje/ /klu dbang lha min dbang po sogs// 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /nor bu bum bzang dpag bsam shing*/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang grub pa'i bcud/ /sman dang sngags sogs thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis khyed la sbyin gyur cig /shing pho khyi zhes bya ba yi/ /lo sar shar ba nas brtsams nas/ /dus rnams kun tu shis bya'i phyir | | bkra shis dge slong 'phags pas spel/ /phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ //༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla na med pa'i bla ma dang*/ /phyag bgyir 'os la phyag 'tshal nas/ /shis pa kun gyis shis bya ba/ khyod ni shis pas shis par bgyi/ /rig stong zung 'jug las byung zhing | | thabs dang shes rab mthar phyin pas/ /sku gnyis zung 'jug brnyes pa po | | sangs rgyas bkra shis deng 'dir shog /ye shes rgya mtsho las byung ba'i/ / lung gi lam gyi dpal bskyed nas/ /'gog pa'i bden pas nyer zhi ba/ /chos kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /bdag dang sems can kun gyi sems/ /nye bar zhi bar nyer gzigs nas/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dpal brnyes pa/ /dge 'dun bkra shis deng 'dir shog /chos khams rab tu zhi ba las byung zhing*/ /nye bar zhi bas zhi ba'i lam bstan pa/ /zhi ba rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor can/ /rin chen dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /sems nyid gdod nas 'od gsal ba/ / dri ma kun gyis ma rnyogs shing*/ /thog mtha' med cing g.yung drung ba/ khams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gdod nas nye bar zhi ba'i dbyings/

/glo bur rtog las rnam grol zhing*/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i rten gyur pa/ /byang chub bkra shis deng 'dir shog /srid pa'i lam gyis yongs bsgyur bas/ /bral dang rnam par smin pa yis | | rang dang gzhan gyi don brnyes pa/ /yon tan bkra shis deng 'dir shog / rnam par mi rtog lhun gyis grub/ /yul dus rnam pa mtha' yas pa'i/ /mdzad pas gdul bya'i don bsgrub pa/ /phrin las bkra shis deng 'dir shog /dri bcas de bzhin nyid dang dri ma med/ /dri med sangs rgyas yon tan rgyal ba'i mdzod/ /gang la dkon mchog dge ba gsum 'byung ba/ /don dam gzigs pa'i yul gyi bkra shis shog /de ltar rigs dang rigs las byung ba yi/ /dkon mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis rab brjod pas/ /rgyal po sras dang srid 'bangs bcas pa kun/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs shing zhabs brtan shog /shing mo phag gi lo sar pa shar ba nas brtsams nas phyogs dang dus thams cad bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ dkon mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis rnam par spel ba zhais bya ba 'di/ 'bal gyi sa'i char dge slong 'phags pas spel nas bskur ba'o// //༈ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnam pa spel ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma dang*/ /skyob mchog dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rgyal po sras dang srid sder bcas pa kun/ /bde legs bya phyir shis pa 'di brjod do/ /bla mar 'os pa gang zhig bla ma dang*/ /mchod 'os brjod 'os nyid du bkur bgyis pas/ /de yang de 'dra nyid du des mdzad pa/ /bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog / gang gi sku ni dpal gyis 'bar ba ste/ /de yi gsung yang bden pa'i dpal gyis brjid | | thugs ni mkhyen brtse'i dpal gyis phun tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas dpal gyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /yi ge ngag tshig rnam par dag pa yis/ /mtshon du med pa'i don yang mtshon byed na/

/mtshon bya kun tu mtshon pa ci smos pa'i/ /dam pa'i chos kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /re res kyang ni lhar bcas zil gnon na | | 'tshogs pa'i gzi yis smos kyang ci 'tshal ba/ /nye bar zhi ba 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i sprin/ /tshogs kyi dam pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rdo rje chos skyong rdo rje'i ngang tshul can/ /gcig pu sra mkhregs rang 'dra'i sde dang bcas/ /rgyal ba mchod cing rgyal sras legs skyong ba/ /chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog | lha dang lha dbang grub pa'i rig 'dzin dang*/ /klu dang klu dbang lha min mi'am ci/ /gnod sbyin 'dab bzangs tshogs rje tshogs bdag sogs/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gang na 'jigs med seng ge'i sgra sgrogs dang | | gang du mthu chen glang po'i stobs 'chang ba/ /de dag kun gyis rgol ba'i dregs bcom nas/ /dbang phyug dam pa'i dbang phyug skyong gyur cig /'di ltar me pho byi ba'i lo sar pa shar ba nas brtsams nas/ dus thams cad du rgyal po yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas shing*/ srid 'bangs dang bcas pa bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di/ shing mo phag gi lo smal po'i zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin par tsom mdo'i gtsug lag khang du spel nas bskur ba'o || || ༈ oṃ swasti sing+nghi/ don thams cad grub pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don grub bsam pa grub pa po/ /chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /don grub shis pa brjod par bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon yon tan mtsho/ / dpal kun gyi ni 'byung gnas te/ /don kun grub par mdzad pa po/ /bla ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /tshogs gnyis tshogs ni rab bsags pas/ /rang gi don kun grub gyur nas/ /gzhan gyi don yang 'grub mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas bkra shis deng 'dir shog

/rgyal ba don kun grub pa yi/ /ye shes rgya mtsho las byung zhing*/ / gang gis bsnyen pa'i don grub pa'i/ /rin chen chos kyi bkra shis shog /don kun grub pa'i rjes zhugs nas/ /gzhan gyi don la nyer gzhol bas/ /gnyis ka'i don kun legs bsgrubs pa/ /dge 'dun bkra shis deng 'dir shog /thub pa don kun legs grub ba'i/ /gsung gis ma lus chos kyi don/ /sgrub par bsgos bzhin legs bsgrub pa'i/ /chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bsod nams dpal gyi legs bskrun pas/ /rang gi mngon mtho'i don grub nas/ /gzhan dag la yang dpal stsol ba/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i bkra shis shog /ma grub pa rnams 'grub byed cing*/ /grub pa rnams kyi dpal skyed pa/ /grub pa rnams dang rig 'dzin gyi/ / bkra shis dam pa deng 'dir shog /gang gi mthu yis de ston pa'i/ /don kun yid bzhin 'grub byed pa/ /nor bu dpag bsam shing sogs kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa deng 'dir shog /de ltar ma lus don kun 'grub byed pa'i/ /bkra shis rmad du byung ba legs brjod pas/ /dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa lha khyod kyi/ /bzhed don thams cad chos bzhin 'grub gyur cig khyod kyi sras sogs khyod kyi rig 'dzin dang*/ /btsun mo dam pa rnams dang de bzhin du/ /blon po mchog sogs khyod kyi rtsa lag kun/ /mchog tu tshe ring ba dang dpal rgyas shog /'gro ba 'di dag zang zing dpal gyis 'byor/ /chos kyi dpal gyis lhag par yid zhi zhing*/ /snod kyang sman dang 'bru dang rin chen sogs/ /'jig rten nyer 'tsho byed pas gang bar shog | me mo glang gi lo sar pa shar ba nas brtsams nas kyang*/ rgyal po chen po sras dang*/ btsun mo dang*/ srid 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ don thams cad grub pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba 'di | me pho byi ba'i lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i shu lnga la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por 'phags pas sbyar nas bskur ba'o//

//༈ oṃ swasti sing+nghaṃ/ bkra shis rnam par spel ba'i tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba | bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la bkra shis phun tshogs shing*/ /de las bkra shis kun 'byung ba/ /bkra shis phul byung rgyal ba la/ / btud nas bkra shis 'di brjod do/ /'dod rgu'i dpal kun 'byung phyir dang*/ / sgrub po'i gtsug gi rgyan gyur cing*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu ste/ /de yi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /stobs sogs sangs rgyas chos rnams kun/ /'byung phyir sangs rgyas rin chen ni/ /rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu ste/ /de yi bkra shis deng 'dir shog / nyon mongs gdung ba sel phyir dang*/ /dge ba'i lo tog rgyu mtshan phyir/ /chos ni sprin chen lta bu ste/ /de yi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /dpag yas 'byung ba'i nyer 'tsho dang*/ /'dus pa zab cing rgya che'i phyir/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa lta bu ste/ /de yi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /de ltar skyabs kyi mchog gyur dkon mchog gis/ /mi dbang khyod ni nye bar bskyabs pa yis/ /rtag tu nyam nga'i gnas rnams kun las khyod | | kun tu bsnyengs bral lham mer bzhugs gyur cig /de dag gis ni mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ /rnam par bcom nas sku tshe'i dpal brnyes te/ /nongs mi mnga' bar 'jig rten thams cad kyi/ /nyer 'tsho nyid du rtag tu bzhugs gyur cig
