| skyob pa'i dpal gyis nyid kyi dpal 'phel nas/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi dpal min rnams bsal te/ /chos kyi dpal dang 'jig rten dpal byung bas/ / rtag tu 'gro ba'i dpal du bzhugs gyur cig /dpal 'byor gang 'dras bdag dpal 'di 'dra zhes/ /ga zha dang ni glu dbyangs sgrogs pa yi/ /sgra yis gzhan don dgyes pa'i ngang tshul can/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi snyan gyi dpal gyur cig /de ltar dpal gyis dpal du byed pa yis/ /bkra shis 'di yis dpal du 'os pa khyod/ / dpal du bya phyir blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang pos bsdebs nas lha yi phyag tu phul/ /sa pho stag gi lo sar pa shar ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + ba nas brtsams nas kyang shin tu bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis rnam par spel ba zhes bya ba 'di/ 'phags pas me mo glang gi smal po'i zla ba la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por bsdebs ) nas bskur ba'o// //༈ phyogs dang dus thams cad du bde legs su byed pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi drin gyis mngon par mtho ba dang*/ /rnam par grol ba'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa/ /bde blag stsol mdzad bla ma la btud de/ /rgyal po khyod la shis pa 'di brjod do/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams kyi rnam 'dren mchog | shākya thub pa dpal gyis lham me ba/ /sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /shar phyogs rin chen yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi/ /rnam par 'dren pa rin chen 'byung gnas ni/ /sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /lho phyogs mya ngan med pa'i 'jig rten gyi/ /rnam par 'dren pa mya ngan med pa'i dpal | | sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /nub phyogs nye bar zhi ba'i 'jig rten gyi/ /rnam par 'dren pa rin chen 'od 'phro ni/

/sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /byang phyogs rnam par rgyal ba'i 'jig rten gyi | | rnam par 'dren pa rgyal ba'i dbang po ni/ /sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /byang shar ting 'dzin gyis brgyan 'jig rten gyi/ /rnam 'dren ting 'dzin glang po dam pa'i dpal/ /sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog | shar lho snying po byang chub brgyan zhes pa'i/ /rnam par 'dren pa pad+mo dam pa'i dpal/ /sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /lho nub rdul dang bral ba'i 'jig rten gyi/ /rnam 'dren nyi ma snang ba dam pa'i dpal/ /sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /nub byang dbang du gyur pa'i 'jig rten gyi | | rnam par 'dren pa gdugs mchog ces bya ba/ /sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /'og phyogs pad+ma can gyi 'jig rten gyi/ /rnam par 'dren pa sangs rgyas pad+mo'i dpal/ /sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /steng phyogs mdangs dga' zhes bya'i 'jig rten gyi/ /rnam par 'dren pa sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal/ /sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /gzhan yang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gang byon dang*/ / da ltar bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad dang*/ /slad nas 'byon 'gyur thub dbang thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas rtag tu bkra shis shog /de ltar dus gsum phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /bkra shis brjod pas rgyal dbang dam pa ni/ /sras dang de dag btsun mo brgyud pa dang*/ /rgyal srid bcas pa rtag tu bkra shis shog/ mi mthun phyogs rnams rang gi ngang gis zhi/

/chos dang zang zing dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs/ /snod rnams thams cad bdud rtsi'i bcud dang ldan/ /lha rnams kun gyis rtag tu skyong gyur cig /de ltar sa mo yos kyi lo sar pa shar nas kyang dus rtag tu bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ rgyal po chen po'i spyan sngar bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di 'phags pa zhes bya bas sa pho stag gi lo/ smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes bdun la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por spel nas bskur ba'o// // ༈ bkra shis su bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub dang chos kyi rgyal po 'jig rten mkhyen/ / ¡Ã thugs rje chen pos ( ¡¶ zha ¡· 'jig rten skyong ba ) 'jig rten phan dgongs pa/ /'jig rten rnam 'dren phyogs bcur bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rgyal ba rgya mtshos mngon par chub gyur cing | | brtse ba rgya mtshos kun nas ¡Ã dag mdzad pas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dbang mdzad pa ) / /skye rgu rgya mtsho'i tshogs la rab bstan pa/ /dam chos rgya mtsho'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog/ gang sngon byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /rgya chen bskyed pa byams pas rab bskrun pas/ /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya che rab rgyas pa/ /mi pham byams pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /skye rgu 'jigs las skyob dang yon tan gyi/ /rten gyur sa rnams kun la rab brten pas/ /gnyis med ye shes snying po'i dpal mnga' ba | | sa yi snying po'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gang la gang gis bsgribs pa'i sgrib pa kun/ /nam mkha' nyid bzhin gzigs pa nyid kyis sgrib/ /rnam par bsal nas gzhan sgrib sel mdzad pa/ /sgrib pa rnam sel bkra shis deng 'dir shog | nyid thugs kun tu bzang po'i ngang gyur pa/ /chos kun kun nas bzang por gzigs gyur te/ /'gro kun kun tu bzang po sgrub mdzad pa/ /kun tu bzang po'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog

/gang thugs gnyis med ye shes rdo rje'i mthus/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rab bcom nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas bsrung ba'i phyir brtson pa/ /phyag na rdo rje'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /'gro kun thugs rje goms pas thugs rje yi/ /ngang du gyur pas sems can kun skyob cing*/ /de mtshan thos pas bde ba'i dpal rgyas pa/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog | chos kun nam mkha'i rang bzhin mkhyen gyur pas/ /nam mkha' ji bzhin nyid thugs rnam dag nas/ /chos rnams kun gyi snying por gang gyur pa/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mkhyen rab gcig bsdus pa/ /rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i gtso bor 'phrul mdzad nas/ /shes rab dam pa'i go 'phang stsol mdzad pa/ /'jam pa'i dpal gyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /gzhan yang rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /slob dang mi slob 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /chos skyong 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pas bkra shis deng 'dir shog /de ltar bkra shis ngo mtshar dpal gyi phul/ /nye bar bkod nas sa bdag sras bcas la/ /phul bas bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa khyed | | lhun po ji bzhin rtag tu zhabs brtan shog /lcags pho 'brug gi lo sar pa shar ba nas bzung ste/ rgyal po chen po yab sras rgyal srid dang bcas pa bde legs su bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di sa mo yos bu'i lo/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco lnga la/ 'phags pa zhes bya bas dpal sa skyar sbyar nas phul ba'o// //༈ dpal ldan khyed sku lhun po ltar brtan zhing*/ /phrin las nyi ma'i 'od ltar phyogs kun khyab/ /dpag bsam shing ltar gzhan yid rdzogs par byed/ / gsum po de yis rgyal sras rgyal gyur cig /shin tu bkra shis so// //oṃ ye ngharma he tu pra bha wā he dun+te ṣān ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro ngha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa ye swā hā/

oṃ sarba bid+yā swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā// // chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod bzhi pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 448PAGE 449
